outline: This course aims (1) to familiarize students with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing, and (2) to develop students’ rhetorical awareness. A review of grammatical ideas at the advanced level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures as well as by doing lively grammar practice exercises. The main topics covered include various parts of speech, tense, clauses, reporting, conjunction, punctuation, and the relationship between grammar and context.
schedule:
Week 1 course introduction
Week 2 subjects, verbs and complements// verbals and phrases
Week 3 independent and dependent clauses
Week 4 sentence fragments
Week 5 tense, voice, and mood
Week 6 subject-verb agreement
Week 7 pronoun-antecedent agreement
Week 8 case of pronouns
Week 9 grammar infographics
Week 10 mid-term exam
Week 11 dangling modifiers
Week 12 misplaced modifiers
Week 13 illogical comparisons and mixed constructions
Week 14 peer teaching videos
Week 15 adjectives and adverbs
Week 16 subordination
Week 17 parallelism
Week 18 final exam
scorePolicy:

3. Grammar infographics and peer teaching videos: 25%
4. Mid-term exam: 20%
5. Final exam: 20%
